name: Pyrvinium Pamoate
summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, evaluated the drug Pyrvinium Pamoate [M]. The computer model gave the drug a medium-level score of 57 for the liver [M]. It also gave the drug a medium-level score of 53 for the heart [M]. There are no specific problems, similar drug issues, or FDA reports listed for this drug [1][2].
